args.summary:
Model of a three-span cast-in-place prestressed concrete box girder bridge (36 + 48 + 36 m, deck width 16 m) completed successfully.

Structure/system: spine_beam_2d elastic beam-column model, cast_in_place_continuous, system = continuous_on_piers (twin-column piers of 8 m and 11 m simulated explicitly, fixed at base).

Girder: single-cell cast box, h=2.4 m, B_top=16 m, B_bot=9 m, t_top=0.25 m, t_bot=0.22 m, webs 0.45 m; integrated section A = 8.417 m^2, I = 7.1876 m^4; C50 concrete (Ec = 34500 MPa), gamma = 26.0 kN/m^3, w = 218.842 kN/m, m = 22.308 t/m. Dead load = girder self-weight only.

Bearings (2 per line, summed as parallel springs): Abutments 0 & 3 — PTFE sliding laminated elastomeric 400x500 mm, 5x11 mm layers (S=10.10, Kv=3.614e6 kN/m, Kh=0, longitudinally free); Pier 1 — plain laminated elastomeric fixed 600x700 mm, 7x11 mm layers (S=14.69, Kv=8.974e6 kN/m, Kh=13091 kN/m); Pier 2 — PTFE sliding 550x650 mm, 6x11 mm layers (S=13.54, Kv=8.075e6 kN/m, Kh=0). Ge = 1.2 MPa (manufacturer value, MR-00 override) used throughout.

Piers: twin circular columns D=1.6 m, C40 (Ec=32500 MPa); merged A=4.021 m^2, I=0.6434 m^4; lengths 8 m and 11 m.

Live load (JTG D60-2015 Class I): 4 design lanes, xi=0.67, qk=10.5 kN/m, Pk = 332/356/332 kN for spans 1/2/3; impact factor mu = 0.1772 from f1 = 2.980 Hz (JTG D60 4.3.2).

Results: first three vertical frequencies 2.980, 4.761, 5.479 Hz; self-weight reactions (4 supports) 2835/10302/10281/2843 kN; self-weight mid-span moments 15.6/23.4/15.7 MNm and support moments -39.8/-39.5 MNm; max live-load positive moment 14.36 MNm and negative moment -11.48 MNm. All L1/L2/L3 checks passed.
